- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: scripts/claude_anthropic_relay.py, lines 130-133, in `_reject` after `self.connection.settimeout(5)` is rescued. When the socket already closed during drain, `send_error(400)` may itself raise on a closed socket; the exception would propagate and skip `close_connection = True`, leaving the server socket open until GC. Suggested minimal fix: Wrap `send_error(400, "Request rejected")` in its own try/except OSError: `try: self.send_error(...) except OSError: pass`. Also assign `self.close_connection = True` before the send so it is set even if send_error fails. Estimated lines changed: 3. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py, lines 1329-1331, the `if not target.tip: continue` guard. The new guard is unreachable in practice because every `_push_targets` path that produces a `tip=""` target also produces a non-empty `remote` that differs from "origin" (delete, tag-only, final-fallback), which trips the unverified-destination check above and `continue`s before this line. Suggested minimal fix: Either remove the guard and the comment as dead code, or add a contract test (`test_target_with_empty_tip_without_remote_skips_merged_pr_check`) that exercises the defensive path so it is actually exercised. The first option is preferred (≤3 lines). Estimated lines changed: 3. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
